title: Enterprise Connectivity: assisted correction posting handling
content:
## Situation and capability
Enterprise Connectivity: When the corresponding accounting action is due, this entry governs assisted correction posting. The accountant posts one network correction credit against its exact original charge and review. The negative receivable adjustment appears immediately in the account and its credit receipt confirms success.

## Handling condition
Before an assisted correction is posted, complete the source rate-error review and use its approved corrected subtotal.

## Invocation
credit_network_4dd38821 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter customer_id
Assisted correction posting uses `customer_id`: Id class — Customer profile identifier copied from find_customers.

## Parameter network_holding_id
Assisted correction posting uses `network_holding_id`: Id class — Network contract identifier copied from find_network_holdings.

## Parameter network_event_id
Assisted correction posting uses `network_event_id`: Id class — Evidence event identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter source_event_id
Assisted correction posting uses `source_event_id`: Id class — Exact original charge or payment identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter related_event_id
Assisted correction posting uses `related_event_id`: Id class — Review identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter amount
Assisted correction posting uses `amount`: Fixed-format class — Signed receivable change in unit USD to two decimals, decimal number to two decimals; supplied after final half-up rounding, stored at two-decimal precision.

## Successful receipt
A dictionary containing event_id (string business-event reference) and amount (USD decimal number to two decimals); receipt presence confirms the accounting action completed.
